hooks.name: Protect Steering Documents
hooks.description: Block agent writes to steering documents

action.command: python -c "import sys, json; d = json.load(sys.stdin); p = json.dumps(d.get('tool_input', {})).replace(chr(92), '/').replace('//', '/'); sys.exit(0) if '.kiro/steering' not in p else (sys.stderr.write('Steering files are human-owned. Ask the user to edit them.'), sys.exit(2))"
